시편-21-1.title: 시편 21장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-21-1.exegesis: 9. let the king hear-- as God's representative, delivered to deliver. Perhaps a better sense is, "Lord, save the king; hear us when we call," or pray.
시편-21-1.theologicalNote: 9. let the king hear-- as God's representative, delivered to deliver. Perhaps a better sense is, "Lord, save the king; hear us when we call," or pray.

시편-21-2.title: 시편 21장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-21-2.exegesis: PSALM 21 Psa 21:1-13 . The pious are led by the Psalmist to celebrate God's favor to the king in the already conferred and in prospective victories. The doxology added may relate to both Psalms; the preceding of petition, chiefly this of thanksgiving, ascribing honor to God for His display of grace and power to His Church in all ages, not only under David, but also under his last greatest successor, "the King of the Jews." 1. thy strength ... thy salvation-- as supplied by Thee.

시편-21-3.exegesis: 2. The sentiment affirmed in the first clause is reaffirmed by the negation of its opposite in the second.

시편-21-4.title: 시편 21장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-21-4.exegesis: 3. preventest-- literally, "to meet here in good sense," or "friendship" ( Psa 59:10 ; compare opposite, Psa 17:13 ). blessings of goodness-- which confer happiness. crown of pure gold-- a figure for the highest royal prosperity.

시편-21-5.title: 시편 21장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-21-5.exegesis: 4-6. (Compare 2Sa 7:13-16 ). The glory and blessedness of the king as head of his line, including Christ, as well as in being God's specially selected servant, exceeded that of all others.

시편-21-8.title: 시편 21장 8절 역사문법적 주해
시편-21-8.exegesis: 7. The mediate cause is the king's faith, the efficient, God's mercy.
시편-21-8.theologicalNote: 7. The mediate cause is the king's faith, the efficient, God's mercy.

시편-21-9.title: 시편 21장 9절 역사문법적 주해
시편-21-9.exegesis: 8. The address is now made to the king. hand-- denotes power, and right hand-- a more active and efficient degree of its exercise. find out-- reach, lay hold of, indicating success in pursuit of his enemies.
시편-21-9.theologicalNote: 8. The address is now made to the king. hand-- denotes power, and right hand-- a more active and efficient degree of its exercise. find out-- reach, lay hold of, indicating success in pursuit of his enemies.

시편-21-10.title: 시편 21장 10절 역사문법적 주해
시편-21-10.exegesis: 9. The king is only God's agent. anger-- literally, "face," as appearing against them. as a fiery oven-- as in it.
시편-21-10.theologicalNote: 9. The king is only God's agent. anger-- literally, "face," as appearing against them. as a fiery oven-- as in it.

시편-21-12.title: 시편 21장 12절 역사문법적 주해
시편-21-12.exegesis: 11. This terrible overthrow, reaching to posterity, is due to their crimes ( Ex 20:5 , 6 ).
시편-21-12.theologicalNote: 11. This terrible overthrow, reaching to posterity, is due to their crimes ( Ex 20:5 , 6 ).

시편-21-13.title: 시편 21장 13절 역사문법적 주해
시편-21-13.exegesis: 12. turn their back-- literally, "place them [as to the] shoulder." against the face of them-- The shooting against their faces would cause them to turn their backs in flight.
